# @wokwi/elements 1.9.2

Wokwi's part drawings as web components (`dist/wokwi-elements.bundle.min.js` from
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wokwi/elements, MIT licence in `LICENSE`; the bundle includes Lit, BSD-3-Clause, with
its notice inline). Used by `web/wokwi.js` to draw the Wokwi virtual circuit in Real Data mode from
`wokwi/udyam-virtual-machine/diagram.json`.
